failure_and_budget_policy.nonzero_child_exit: Stop further admission, drain owned children normally, retain failure and prefixes; no automatic replacement.
failure_and_budget_policy.resource_end: Checkpoint and retain unfinished work; no analysis claim requiring completion until all8 reach the fixed endpoint.
failure_and_budget_policy.scientific_failure: Report all eight and every failed fixed screen. No automatic extension, latest-window search, or production launch.

late_window_preparation_assessment.autocorrelation_definition: Within each fixed100ps window subtract that window mean, use lag-wise N-k covariance normalization, and retain normalized covariance through50ps. A zero variance yields an explicitly undefined normalized curve, not a pass. No automatic correlation-time cutoff or iid sample-count claim.
late_window_preparation_assessment.autocorrelation_report: Retain each scalar correlation through50ps for each100ps window and the raw fixed-window histories; no adaptive truncation or effective-independent-sample claim is required. An unresolved slow mode prevents an equilibrium claim.
late_window_preparation_assessment.block_estimates: For every scalar and fixed RDF bin, retain all contiguous block means at each fixed size and their sample SD/SEM within each window. Do not select a favorable block size. These within-chain estimates are descriptive and may understate error when correlations extend beyond20ps.
late_window_preparation_assessment.boundary_convention: Each window is left-open/right-closed, matching the original scalar analysis convention.
late_window_preparation_assessment.equal_chain_mean_difference_uncertainty: Eight differences, nominal Student-t df7; the across-chain mean cannot hide a failed individual scalar screen.

original_short_MSD_window_failure_preser.compatibility_interpretation: Failure-to-detect-difference screen; a wide CI is not evidence of equivalence.
original_short_MSD_window_failure_preser.equivalence_interpretation: The complete paired-chain 95% CI must lie inside the prespecified symmetric absolute margin.

purpose: Test whether the fixed additional400ps resolves the complete original cohort preparation failures; this is not a repair of its transport-window failure.

OH_HOH_distributions.normalization: Density in each fixed bin plus explicit underflow/overflow counts and fractions; no out-of-range geometry is discarded.
OH_HOH_distributions.sampling: Every1ps full-state checkpoint in the two left-open/right-closed late windows; all216molecules, both OH bonds and one HOH angle per molecule.

structural_reporting_policy_proposed_for.coordination_definition: Twice unordered OO pairs within3.5angstrom divided by frames*N.
structural_reporting_policy_proposed_for.histogram_edges: OO edges start at 0, use full0.02angstrom increments below L/2, and append the exact stored L/2 if needed; normalize any final partial shell by its exact volume.
structural_reporting_policy_proposed_for.max_bin_difference_and_0p1_reference: Descriptive only, preserving v2; never a new mandatory pass rule.
structural_reporting_policy_proposed_for.normalization: Unordered minimum-image OO pairs divided by frames*N*(N-1)/2 times shell_volume/V.
structural_reporting_policy_proposed_for.range: 0 to half the unchanged fixed cubic box; preserve all bins.
structural_reporting_policy_proposed_for.review_before_any_long_preparation: The offline scalar/RDF analysis definitions and implementation must be independently reviewed and frozen before launch; no hard RDF gate is adopted by this document.
structural_reporting_policy_proposed_for.uncertainty: Per-seed5/10/20ps block diagnostics plus pointwise nominal df7 intervals across the eight fixed-window differences. No simultaneous coverage, equivalence or calibrated liquid false-alarm rate is claimed.
